templates.example: Fauna uses the walkway around a silent equipment hoist to reach the outward trail into The Swamp.
Following a raised culvert lip, Deaclaw avoids the main approach and crosses into The Center Podium.
Solus takes a longer way around by the narrow rim of a fern bed, arriving in The Mountains away from the main exit.
Hiro takes a longer way around by a row of exposed dark stones, arriving in The Mountains away from the main exit.
Luvy takes a longer way around by a disused quarry ramp, arriving in The Center Podium away from the main exit.
A glint at ankle height stops Akesel in The Swamp. The wire across the trail is left untouched as Akesel goes around it.
Hiro retraces the approach to an old wheel rut through the sand and finds a way across the boundary into The Swamp.
Jokin pauses beside the trail in The Center Podium and eats the sealed rations. The empty wrapper goes back into the pack.
Deaclaw kneels to work a pebble out of a boot. On the exposed edge of a nearby paving stone are three fresh warning scratches.
An unexpected clatter in The Desert makes Joshi retreat without checking the ground. Joshi steps into the drainage shaft and dies in the fall.
In The Tundra, Rick retrieves a sealed arena charge and its matching remote from a closed equipment case.
Kowalik strikes from inside a supply shelter in The Desert as Adur edges through the entrance. The sharpened branch wounds the side. Adur reaches the path before collapsing from fatal blood loss.
Behind a split timber block in The Swamp, Joshi spots the outline of hand axe through a torn panel and reaches around to collect it.
An uncovered drain lies behind Shadz in The Swamp. Suggs pelts the path ahead with stones, forcing a retreat. Shadz steps into the shaft and dies in the fall.
Solus tilts a loose base at a broad-blade tool rack in The Mountains, freeing machete from a jammed retaining clip before taking it along.
Shield stops in The Center Podium and drinks the remaining clean water from the flask, setting the empty container aside.
The breeze in The Center Podium makes Adur stop and rig the emergency blanket across a low gap. Adur rests behind it, then takes it down.
Hiro looks beneath a raised impact-testing deck in The Tundra and finds spiked mace secured inside a low access frame; undoing the catch releases it to carry away.
A distant cough interrupts the stillness in The Forest. Jokin waits without answering; no second cough comes, and the source remains hidden.
Rick and Adur retrace the approach to a narrow passage between concrete barriers and find a way across the boundary into The Swamp.
AMyriad follows a faded equipment tag to a canvas pole bundle in The Center Podium, unfolding the material to find and claim spear.
Jokin slides a warped cover away from a fitted sheath drawer in The Forest, exposing hunting knife and lifting it free to carry.

Skizzo waits for the weight of Ary to settle on a supply platform in The Mountains before pulling its damaged support. The structure folds inward. Pinned under the fallen decking, Ary dies from the injuries.
The gate is already falling when Hiro draws Rick toward it in The Center Podium. An outstretched foot trips Rick; Hiro rolls clear, leaving the gate to crush the fallen tribute to death.
Solus slides a warped cover away from a club-rack alcove in The Center Podium, exposing wooden club and lifting it free to carry.
A damaged return tray at a bolt-channel testing station in The Center Podium rattles when Jokin checks it; crossbow has lodged behind the tray and is retrieved.
Waiting low behind a barrier in The Swamp, Hiro strikes at Akesel's knee with a metal rod. Once Akesel falls, Hiro strikes the head. Akesel dies beside the checkpoint.
At a sighting-panel bracket in The Mountains, Skizzo works bow and arrows upward until its remaining transport tie slips loose, then takes possession of the find.

Skizzo corners Hiro at a cache in The Center Podium and stabs the side. Before another blow, Hiro topples the cache into the attacker's path. Clambering over its lid, Hiro escapes alive with a hand over the bleeding wound.
Rick wraps the emergency blanket around his shoulders in The Desert and settles down for the night with it tucked close.
Searching over a barrier in The Forest, Shadz does not see Flurris waiting below. A hard shove tips Shadz onto the broken footing. The head injury proves fatal.

A stab from Shield opens a wound in Solus's thigh beside a supply shelter in The Swamp. Dirt flung at the attacker's eyes buys Solus time to crawl beneath the wall. Solus gets away with the wound still bleeding.
Beside a sorting table in The Center Podium, Emma snaps a length of discarded cord toward Luvy. The cord catches the table leg instead, giving Luvy room to retreat.
Beside Ary's cover in The Mountains, Luvy spots a revealing drag mark and brushes it aside with a branch. A deliberately noisy departure sends the search along the open lane instead.

In The Center Podium, Siegfried claims the numbered posts form a route to fresh supplies. Tobi follows them back to the same starting post and recognizes the joke when Siegfried asks how the tour went.
Joshi slides a sharp grille across Jokin's thigh from beneath a platform in The Center Podium. The severed clothing catches on the frame, leaving Jokin trapped long enough to die from the leg wound.
Joshi lunges across a low barrier with a metal sliver in The Center Podium. Skizzo kicks the barrier upward into the forearm; the sliver flies into an inaccessible recess as Skizzo backs away.
While Hiro untangles clothing from a rail in The Tundra, Rick takes spiked mace from within reach. Hiro frees the snag just in time to identify the departing thief.
A shallow runnel leads straight toward Rick's sleeping place in The Forest. Flurris helps scrape a diversion around the hollow so runoff will pass it by.
Suggs invites Tobi to a brief meal in The Center Podium. The rations are shared and finished, earning a grateful nod.
Siegfried, Adur, Shield and Jokin squeeze past the gap behind the loudspeaker tower and reach The Forest.

Behind a marker in The Center Podium, Rick waits with a sharpened scrap. The lunge wounds Joshi's shoulder, but Joshi forces Rick back into the marker before escaping behind a bank of earth with the wound still bleeding.
A hidden pit catches Marcos on a trail in The Forest. A broken stake leaves a bleeding thigh wound, but roots along the wall let him climb out alive.
At a dividing rail in The Swamp, Deaclaw traps Suggs's forearm and drives a sharp scrap into the shoulder. Suggs escapes the grip, but the shoulder wound causes a fatal collapse nearby.
Luvy waits behind the central beacon, then swings a broken pipe at Ary. The impact tips Ary through the floor-panel gap. The basement fall kills Ary.
Someone has arranged a water delivery for Kowalik in The Center Podium. No signature identifies the sender; Kowalik collects the water flask from the parcel.
Crouching through a dry channel beneath a tilted platform, Shadz and Emma get clear of the exposed route and into The Desert.
Kowalik accepts a drink from Hiro in The Desert. They split the remaining water and set down the empty flask, grateful for the truce.
The Center Podium landing pulls free of its wall beneath Shield. There is no footing left to catch. Shield falls into the basement and dies.
A sponsor parachute drifts into The Center Podium. Adur opens the food parcel to find sealed rations.
Solus swings a loose inspection grille into Marcos at waist height in The Forest. Its sharp corner tears the side, and Marcos dies while trying to brace the wound against the grille.
Shadz shows Flurris the difference between a service arrow and a genuine route marker in The Desert, preventing a detour into a dead end.
Hiro follows the old power-relay corridor below the stand and comes out in The Swamp.
Shield slips through a hanging mesh screen in The Center Podium while Luvy follows the wider path. From behind the mesh, Shield watches the pursuer pass the wrong entrance.
Siegfried tries to leave the storeroom when generator smoke begins filling it. The swollen door holds fast. The trapped tribute dies from inhaling the smoke.
Deaclaw descends the ruined stairwell in The Center Podium, feeling for each step. A loose tread tips forward, pitching him over the broken edge. Deaclaw dies in the fall.

Footsteps tell Emma that Deaclaw is about to find Kowalik's hiding place in The Center Podium. Emma makes a conspicuous dash down the far trail. Deaclaw follows the decoy, letting Kowalik escape; Emma then loses the chase in cover without injury.
Emma spots familiar fruit on a bush in The Swamp and gathers the ripe berries, eating each handful at the patch.
The announcement sends Marcos out of the Mountains and into The Tundra.
Shield crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and drives a jagged sign bracket into Deaclaw's chest, inflicting a fatal wound.
Akesel catches sight of a crocodile beneath the crossing in The Swamp and retreats onto the high boards. Its lunge reaches only the walkway supports.
Keeping low beside a notch between two split trunks, Rick and Adur pass out of sight of the main trail and into The Center Podium.
Emma takes the warning about the Forest seriously and heads into The Mountains.
Solus climbs a narrow shelf in The Mountains as wolves close in along the trail. Unable to follow, the pack moves on, leaving Solus unharmed.
Joshi and Emma mark the ends of a watch route in The Center Podium with loose pebbles. Each promises to return to the meeting point before the other sleeps.
The station gate is almost down when Flurris sweeps a foot behind Jokin's ankle. Jokin lands beneath it as Flurris rolls away. The gate's weight kills Jokin.

Fauna chases Shield toward a supply shelter in The Center Podium. Adur pulls Shield through the doorway and braces a fallen beam against the door. While Fauna forces it open, Adur and Shield escape through the rear gap. Nobody is injured.
Akesel takes the warning about the Desert seriously and heads into The Swamp.
Gulliver takes a gully for a shortcut in The Mountains and reaches a sheer wall. Wolves fill the route behind, trapping him. The attack is fatal.
At the lee of a concrete partition, Emma brushes away the debris that would crackle under a restless sleeper.
A disused delivery ramp behind the podium booths takes Flurris, Skizzo and Suggs above the cluttered lanes and into The Swamp.
Rick places bow and arrows on a low wall in The Swamp and steps back so Jokin can take it without coming closer. The gift is accepted without a bargain.
Keeping low beside a breach in a low retaining wall, Emma and Shadz pass out of sight of the main trail and into The Center Podium.
Rick and Adur squeeze past a ledge beneath an overhanging slab and reach The Center Podium.
Jokin tests a dark corridor floor with a loose brick, exposing a covered maintenance pit before stepping onto it.
Joshi gathers ripe berries beside the trail in The Swamp and saves the handful in a leaf wrapper.
A patch of undisturbed wrapping stands out beside a route post in The Center Podium. Adur checks the hollow below and finds signal mirror to carry away.

Jokin brings branches to a low wall in The Center Podium while Siegfried and Fauna position a fallen sheet against it. Fauna secures the base with stones as Siegfried holds it steady. They close the remaining gaps with branches and rest together beside an unobstructed exit.
A sheltered ticket recess gives Skizzo somewhere to lean without facing the main podium approach.
AMyriad notices Skizzo trying to rest beneath a loose flap in The Center Podium. By tucking the flap behind its frame together, they make the small covered space usable for both.
Solus squeezes between a dead trunk and a steep forest bank. The trunk rolls into the gap, crushing him to death.
Luvy takes the warning about the Tundra seriously and heads into The Mountains.
Deaclaw packs up after the broadcast and moves from the Swamp into The Center Podium.
At an abandoned sorting stand in The Tundra, Chaos notices one drawer sitting slightly proud. storm lantern is caught behind its false bottom, and Chaos frees it.
Siegfried and AMyriad take a longer way around by a row of exposed dark stones, arriving in The Center Podium away from the main exit.
Solus crouches behind a mountain outcrop as a sudden gust tears gravel from the ridge, waiting for a lull before descending.

Marcos finds a broad, level step in The Forest and lies still to deal with the bleeding thigh. The first cloth fold slips, so Marcos starts again and holds it in place until blood no longer seeps through.
Chaos and Skizzo use a dusty panel in The Tundra to mark which approaches need watching. Chaos takes the first turn and wakes Skizzo with a soft knock for the next.
Flurris crosses what looks like leaf-strewn ground in The Forest. The pit beneath gives way, and the fall onto a stake kills him.
The argument offers an excuse more readily than an agreement. Marcos takes sealed arena charge from Hiro in a dispute over the camp rules.
An ice-coated service door will not open for Tobi in the tundra. Repeated attempts waste the remaining strength; Tobi collapses outside and freezes to death.
Joshi retraces the approach to a narrow levee through the reeds and finds a way across the boundary into The Center Podium.
Emma drives Chaos backward onto a concealed tundra cutting; the crust breaks and the fall is fatal.
Rick tries to swim the gap beneath a crossing in The Swamp. A crocodile catches him before the far support, and Rick dies underwater.
Tobi squeezes into a desert inspection tunnel for shade. A corroded roof panel folds down and traps him beneath the settling sand, causing fatal suffocation.
Fauna notices a floating reed mat drifting away from the swamp bank and steps back onto firm roots before it separates.
Luvy knocks a support from a ruined balcony, but Adur grips a window frame and climbs into the building before the floor falls.
In The Forest, Skizzo steps too close to a boar in the undergrowth. A quick climb onto a fallen tree keeps the tusks out of reach until it moves on.
Marcos pushes AMyriad over an ice-coated retaining wall; the fall onto the frozen footing is fatal.
Marcos notices a snow shelf bending over the tundra path and crawls away before its outer edge collapses.
Adur crosses the boundary into The Swamp and tips a landing beneath Rick, trapping him between the planks and the bank to drown.
Akesel crosses the boundary into The Forest and jams a sharpened branch through a gap in Siegfried's cover, inflicting a fatal chest wound.

Packed snow provides building material within reach. Skizzo digs a shallow hollow on the sheltered side of a snowbank in The Tundra, packing snow around the edges to keep the wind off while leaving room to crawl out.

A level platform in The Forest lets Solus settle without pulling at the earlier thigh wound. Luvy adjusts the cloth binding and keeps a steady hand on the pad until Solus can take over without renewed bleeding.
Solus notices fern fronds sagging over a deep forest hollow and probes the ground with a branch before walking around it.
Adur stops behind a panel in The Swamp and carefully shifts weight from heel to toe. The squeaky boots make both halves of the movement audible.
Skizzo and Ary find water collecting beneath a loose outlet in The Mountains. Together they angle the outlet toward a clean patch of stone and share the small flow.
AMyriad opens the parcel suspended under a sponsor's silver canopy in The Center Podium. Inside is an emergency blanket, which joins the carried supplies.
Marcos skirts a mountain scree fan whose lower edge is unsupported. The whole strip slides into the gully, carrying him to a fatal landing.

Shadz tries to clear driftwood from a swamp boardwalk gap. The jam breaks suddenly, pulling him into the channel and beneath the supports to drown. The same channel beneath the boardwalk where Fauna died earlier has now claimed Shadz.

Solus knocks a support from a ruined balcony while Joshi crosses, sending him down with the masonry in a fatal collapse. Shield's earlier death and Joshi's final moments share the same place: the ruined stairwell.

Snow hides an old hole in the frozen lake from Ary. The covering crust collapses, and the smooth ice offers no grip; Ary drowns beside the opening. At the frozen lake, Ary has met an end at the very spot where Adur died earlier.
Skizzo enters The Center Podium, meeting Chaos to exchange directions.
Joshi tries to slip behind AMyriad's resting platform in The Desert. The support carries every footstep; warned by its vibration, AMyriad blocks the gap and drives Joshi back.

Hiro shelters beneath an overturned panel in The Swamp. With the entrance in view, Hiro holds a cloth pad firmly over the earlier side wound until the bleeding stops, leaving the panel only after checking the pad.
Gulliver slams a fallen branch into Suggs at a forest gate, causing a fatal head injury.
Suggs breaks a weakened rail above the swamp boardwalk channel and drives Chaos into the gap. The current carries her beneath the decking to drown.
Pausing at a shallow cutting behind a snow fence to check the ground ahead, Akesel then continues into The Mountains.
Deaclaw tips a heavy swamp equipment stand onto Emma; pinned beneath its frame, Emma dies from crushing injuries.
Beside an abandoned sled track, Rick finds a firm patch and spends a quiet stretch knocking packed snow from the boots.
Pausing at the hard ground around a salt pan to check the ground ahead, Shadz then continues into The Swamp.
A stair landing in the Center Podium gives way beneath Shield. Skizzo drags a fallen door across the gap and steadies it while Shield crawls to the corridor.
At the edge of the ruined stand, Suggs puts emergency blanket on an intact seat and releases the grip for good.

A loose clothing seam gives Rick enough fabric to bind the bleeding shoulder in The Center Podium. Seated with both approaches visible, Rick reties the dressing until it holds pressure and the bleeding ceases.
Jokin hauls up a sloping trunk in The Forest as Fauna approaches. Crossing the branches and dropping behind a fallen tree gives Jokin time to escape.
Solus drops a loose lookout brace onto Kowalik on the forest path below; the head injury kills him.
Hiro kicks a board loose beneath Joshi at the swamp crossing. Joshi catches a support post, hauls onto the next platform, and escapes along the boardwalk while Hiro struggles with the gap.
Using a dry recess beneath a slab for the night, Solus traces the exit by touch before lying down.
Shadz tests the woven branches along a reinforced swamp bank, then settles on the firm edge for a rest.
Gulliver crosses the boundary into The Desert and drops a heavy road marker onto Shadz from a low wall; the head injury is fatal.
Hiro examines a faded maintenance diagram on the swamp railing and matches its fork to the reed-lined paths nearby.
Adur's machete catches beneath a sorting tray during a struggle in The Swamp; Rick lifts the tray edge and claims the weapon while Adur retreats without being struck.
Akesel, Marcos and Suggs all avoid the announced danger and move into The Forest.
At a low partition in The Tundra, Deaclaw reaches across while Emma inspects the other side and takes spear. The missing weight makes Emma turn in time to see the culprit.
Deaclaw tests the footing on a corridor scattered with broken tiles, then chooses a firm place to rest.
A dry chuckle from the Whispering Tin interrupts Emma in The Desert. It names Flurris as someone who cannot be trusted, souring her opinion without offering proof.
Skizzo's hand axe catches across a mesh-screen opening in The Tundra; Adur pulls it free, strikes Skizzo in the head with the seized hand axe, and retains the hand axe after the wound kills him.
Rick pretends to point out a problem with a marker in The Center Podium. When Luvy leans closer, Rick takes hand axe; a glance back reveals the trick and its author.

Beside an empty reel in The Forest, Gulliver pins Solus's weapon wrist to the rim, takes the bow and arrows, and pulls an arrow from the seized quiver and drives the point into Solus's chest; Solus dies against the reel while the weapon stays with Gulliver.
Siegfried hides a sharpened stake beneath leaves on a forest trail, then rattles a branch to draw Adur forward. Adur falls onto the stake and dies before reaching the path again.
Suggs guides Jokin's wooden club into the bend of an inspection rail in The Swamp, twists it free of the trapped grip, and steps back with it while Jokin retreats uninjured.

At a service shutter in The Tundra, Luvy hears AMyriad coming through the opposite passage. Luvy pulls the damaged release as AMyriad passes underneath, dropping the shutter onto him and causing fatal crushing injuries.

Solus and Hiro reach a broadcast dais in The Center Podium from separate lanes. Solus ducks behind the lectern, then pulls it forward as Hiro steps down; the heavy base strikes his head and kills him.
Flurris warns Rick away from a wasp nest on the forest trail and guides him around it through the ferns.
Pausing at a row of cut stumps to check the ground ahead, Shield, Gulliver and Suggs then continue into The Swamp.
Adur steadies a loose bridge plank with a boot while Kowalik crawls across the mountain gorge.
Fauna, Siegfried and Luvy check the way through a packed track beside a frozen ditch before committing to the crossing into The Mountains.
Suggs approaches AMyriad with empty hands in The Center Podium and offers an apology. After a long pause, AMyriad agrees to let the words stand without another argument.
With trouble announced, Joshi, Gulliver, Jokin and Suggs head into The Tundra together.
Shield turns the emergency blanket into a low sunshade in The Desert, resting under it before folding it away.
AMyriad follows a clear set of tracks across the boundary into The Swamp.

At a service shutter in The Center Podium, Tobi hears Jokin coming through the opposite passage. Tobi pulls the damaged release as Jokin passes underneath, dropping the shutter onto him and causing fatal crushing injuries.
Beneath a disused frame in The Desert, Rick lets a loose panel rock in the breeze to mask small movements. Gulliver passes without finding the hiding place; the earlier thigh wound remains untreated.
Rather than rush toward a sound in The Center Podium, Solus waits behind cover until the path is quiet.
A short length of packing cord protrudes from beneath a ledge in The Center Podium. Deaclaw follows it to sealed rations tucked behind the support and takes the find.
A low loading ramp in The Swamp gives Fauna a sudden change of level when Deaclaw swings the machete toward Fauna; the machete misses as Fauna drops behind its solid side.
A signal arch in The Center Podium separates Joshi from the approaching Marcos. Joshi pushes its unbolted side frame over during the charge, fatally pinning Marcos beneath the metal.

Fresh supplies arrive at the central ground by cargo drone. Rick opens the crate on the Center Podium and packs sealed rations for the road, placing a water flask and an emergency blanket beside the crate for the next visitor.
The Whispering Tin has the appearance of equipment with an extra complication. Luvy acquires Whispering Tin. The lid seems to mutter about the competition.
Chaos finds a pair of boots in a supply crate and pulls them on. The first step squeaks against the ground.
Fauna lifts the Crooked Compass. The needle settles with great confidence on a direction that offers very little safety.
Helping each other out of the scramble, Emma and Shadz reach The Swamp.

Luvy loses footing when Shield trips the approaching tribute beside the central water cache. Shield pushes the heavy tank off its stand. It crushes Luvy to death; Shield takes water flask and an emergency blanket.

Emma is still reaching for the food crate's lid when Suggs pulls a sharpened scrap from within. Suggs stabs Emma in the chest, causing death beside the crate, then takes sealed rations and an emergency blanket.
A loose bar becomes a weapon in Tobi's hands beside the central tools. The strike hits Gulliver in the head and proves fatal. Tobi takes rescue rope and an emergency blanket from the supplies.
Rick and Hiro help each other take the tundra exit into The Tundra.
The spear lies among the equipment at the crowded center. Jokin reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a spear, then backs away from the scramble.
Ary and Hiro get each other clear of the fighting and cross into The Forest.
Skizzo and Deaclaw find an exit together and head into The Mountains.
Skizzo claims a spiked mace from the central weapon rack and moves clear of the opening fight.
AMyriad and Akesel find an exit together and head into The Desert.
Jokin snatches a crossbow from the Center Podium rack and backs clear.
Siegfried takes a wooden club from the Center Podium weapon rack and retreats from the scramble.
The hand axe occupies a small part of the contested weapon rack. Fauna reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a hand axe, then backs away from the scramble.
At the Center Podium weapon rack, Joshi grabs a bow and a quiver of arrows before backing out of the scramble.
The tool rack offers something useful for getting out of trouble. AMyriad chooses rescue rope over a dramatic entrance. Sensible television.
AMyriad, Marcos, Chaos and Suggs choose an early exit and cross into The Tundra.
The central tools include one unusually reflective distraction. Ary pockets signal mirror. The broadcast has acquired a lookout.

The fight at the water rack spills across the open podium. Deaclaw sees Luvy freeze as a fight breaks out at the central water rack. Grabbing his sleeve, Deaclaw pulls him behind a concrete supply barrier before a thrown stone hits the rack.
Announcer: “We recommend checking the lower-pass boundary lamps while the mountains route is still available: the scheduled rockfall starts tonight and this region will remain closed afterward.”
Luvy, Skizzo and Ary take the same exit from the bloodbath into The Mountains.
Flurris, Rick and Shadz choose an early exit and cross into The Forest.
Tobi reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a machete, then backs away from the scramble.
Skizzo, Gulliver and Jokin leave the fighting behind and move toward The Swamp.
Kowalik, Joshi and Shield take the tundra exit into The Tundra.

An outstretched arm cuts across the central ration table. Gulliver reaches across the central ration table to grab Skizzo. Skizzo slides underneath it, tips the table toward Gulliver, and crawls clear of the falling supplies.

The ledge leaves little shelter from a fall of rock. Deaclaw takes a narrow mountain ledge beneath an unstable scree slope. Falling stones knock him off the path, and the fall is fatal. Jokin's earlier death and Deaclaw's final moments share the same place: the narrow ledge.
Announcer: “Our mountains microphones remain live during the scheduled rockfall, but the available movement is outward along the marked descent; please reach the Center Podium promptly.”
Announcer: “Rockfall has sealed the mountain return passes; our mountains cameras will provide scenery shots only, and the region stays closed for the rest of the games.”
Siegfried takes a hunting knife from the Center Podium weapon rack and retreats from the scramble.
Unwilling to risk the scramble, Flurris, Solus, Kowalik and Marcos head into The Forest.
Announcer: “The forest departure is tonight's priority shot; complete the marked woodland exits before nightfall brings the controlled burn and closes the region for the rest of the games.”

The channel’s green edges disguise a softer center. Siegfried follows a reed channel into deep swamp mud. Each attempt to climb out sinks him farther, until the water closes overhead. Siegfried drowns.
The loudest plans near the supplies do not mention thirst. Shield secures water flask while louder contestants argue about strategy.
Most eyes are on the weapons; the food lies lower down. Jokin slips beneath the fight for the central supplies and claims sealed rations.
Unwilling to risk the scramble, Hiro, Akesel, Gulliver and Siegfried head into The Mountains.

The crates divide the podium into awkward little passages. Solus swings a sharpened scrap at AMyriad over the central supply crates. AMyriad ducks beneath the swing and kicks a loose crate into the path, escaping the attack empty-handed.
A thin reflective packet lies within reach on the supply rack. Jokin grabs emergency blanket, already planning for the first cold night.
Joshi, Chaos, Suggs and Deaclaw leave the opening chaos together and reach The Swamp.
Gravel rolls off the narrow ledge in The Mountains as Luvy steps forward. The weakened edge follows it, dropping him onto the rocks far below. The fall kills him.
Announcer: “Fire is spreading beneath the canopy; our forest coverage now follows the marked woodland exits toward the Center Podium, so anyone still departing should keep moving.”
Announcer: “For the rest of this game, the forest is unavailable because of the controlled burn; our coverage has moved to the surviving locations.”
Announcer: “For anyone still considering the swamp, tonight's permanent flood ends its availability; leave by the raised causeway before nightfall and join our Center Podium coverage.”
Jokin, Ary and Joshi leave the fighting behind and move toward The Desert.
Chaos leaves the bloodbath for The Forest.
The toppled crate offers a brief gap in the scramble. Adur rescues storm lantern from a toppled supply crate.
Announcer: “The tundra departure is tonight's priority shot; complete the pole-marked exit before nightfall brings the fatal temperature drop and closes the region for the rest of the games.”
Announcer: “The swamp exit sequence is in progress because the permanent flood has begun; the raised causeway is the remaining direction of travel toward the Center Podium.”
Announcer: “Floodwater has closed the swamp boardwalk network; the swamp boundary will remain shut and the boardwalk exit markers should not be treated as an invitation back.”
Announcer: “For anyone still considering the desert, tonight's permanent cooling shutdown ends its availability; leave by the service-road exit before nightfall and join our Center Podium coverage.”
Announcer: “Our desert microphones remain live during the permanent cooling shutdown, but the available movement is outward along the service-road exit; please reach the Center Podium promptly.”
Announcer: “The permanent cooling shutdown has permanently retired the desert from play; the service-road exit now marks the edge of a closed region.”

The water checkpoint is not visible from this stretch of desert. AMyriad walks across the desert through the midday heat, searching for a water checkpoint. Disoriented, AMyriad circles the same dune until collapsing. Heatstroke proves fatal before shelter is found.
Announcer: “The tundra fatal temperature drop is now active, and our camera view is centered on the pole-marked exit; finish the escape to the Center Podium while it is possible.”
Announcer: “The tundra is permanently closed after the fatal temperature drop; the pole-marked exit is no longer an entrance, so please choose an open region.”
Deaclaw discovers rescue rope suspended from an old survey post.
A gap under the ruined hide invites a closer search. Chaos unearths storm lantern beneath a collapsed bird hide.

Adur steps onto a rotten plank in The Swamp. It breaks over the channel beneath the boardwalk, dropping him into the current. Swept beneath the remaining boards, Adur drowns. At the channel beneath the boardwalk, Adur has met an end at the very spot where Shadz died earlier.
Shield ventures onto the frozen lake in The Tundra, following a line of windblown snow. The ice opens beneath his feet. Repeated attempts to scramble out fail, and Shield drowns.
Fauna, Kowalik, Skizzo and Joshi choose an early exit and cross into The Desert.

The low edge offers no obstacle to a lost step. Gulliver crouches behind the ridge checkpoint and sweeps a branch across Akesel's ankles. Akesel tumbles off the exposed mountain path; the fall is fatal.
The old marker and the newer scratches finally make sense together. Marcos matches the earlier scratches to a damaged trail marker. The warning has a direction.
Joshi takes out the gathered berries in The Swamp and eats them one by one until none remain.

The sand offers little help in finding the same path after dark. Akesel scrapes a sleeping hollow behind a dune in The Desert, away from the open trail. A ring of stones marks the way out before darkness hides the landmarks.
Fallen leaves hide the shape of the old hollow. Hiro cuts across a leaf-covered hollow in the forest. The ground gives way into an old hunting pit, and Hiro dies from the fall.
A boar trapped beside the roots in The Forest turns on Akesel. The charge knocks him off balance, and the tusk wounds are fatal.
Rick checks the way through a line of old forester blazes before committing to the crossing into The Swamp.
Adur retrieves bow and arrows from the dusty broadcast floor.
The rocks conceal a store intended for passing climbers. Solus opens a climbing cache and takes rescue rope.
Rick notices a desert wall bowing outward and backs across the service road before it collapses into the sand.
The low stone pile offers a pause out of the open. Gulliver shelters behind a cairn and studies the next ridge.

A ring of stones hides much of the glow from a shared fire in The Forest. Shield finishes the screen while Suggs gathers fallen wood and Gulliver stands lookout. Their rotation carries on through the night, giving all three a share of the warmth and sleep.
Marcos loosens a snow shelf above a tundra hollow and stamps until it collapses onto Tobi, burying him until Tobi suffocates.

A jammed food locker in The Center Podium takes three people to search safely. Kowalik watches the trail while Adur and Flurris work the lid free. Inside are three sealed ration packs; each tribute carries one away.
Shadz comes along the low approach to an inspection pit in The Center Podium as Joshi crosses its cover. Shadz tips a loose cover panel; Joshi falls onto the concrete below and dies from the impact.

Announcer: “A forecast note concerning the desert sandstorm. Desert residents, a sandstorm is due tonight. Please make any necessary introductions before visibility drops. The close-up cameras are ready.”

Jokin checks the way through a scree-free strip beside the ridge before committing to the crossing into The Forest.
Gulliver crosses the boundary into The Mountains and pulls a rotten quarry plank from under Adur, causing a fatal fall into the cutting.
Jokin and Solus both avoid the announced danger and move into The Center Podium.

Announcer: “The forecast desk has no further update for this location. The mountain rain has stopped. We can see the passes again, and a few of you have selected some very ambitious routes.”
Jokin helps Joshi sit on a low step in The Desert to reach the earlier shoulder wound. Joshi holds a cloth pad steady while Jokin secures it; together they stop the bleeding before trying to stand.
There is little shadow on this stretch of sand. Shadz conserves energy in the narrow shadow of a dune marker.
The canopy breaks up the view from the trail. Chaos waits beneath the canopy until the distant footsteps fade.

Flurris and Gulliver approach opposite sides of a loading rail in The Center Podium. When Gulliver climbs over, Flurris shoves an empty trolley into the legs; the fall onto an exposed mounting bolt kills him.

Marcos breaks through lake ice near the tundra bank. Suggs pushes a fallen branch across the opening and stays flat on the snow while Marcos uses it to crawl out.
Akesel finds signal mirror while looking through a checkpoint in the shade.

Recognition does nothing to make the distance between them feel safer. Rick recognizes Gulliver at a trail shelter in The Swamp and plants a foot across the entrance. Neither trusts the other enough to close the distance. After a long silence, Gulliver backs away from the doorway, leaving the grudge unsettled.

Announcer: “Please include the forest wind in your evening arrangements. Forest guests, strong winds are expected tonight. Loose branches may interrupt your arrangements. Our cameras have been secured.”

Announcer: “The forest wind has eased. A few changes to the canopy, but nothing to delay the programme.”
The rim is close enough to examine from the route. Emma hauls water flask from a watertight supply drum.
As Adur opens a ration pack in The Tundra, Kowalik grabs sealed rations and slides down a steep trail bank. Unwilling to chance the blind drop, Adur stops above.

Siegfried shakes a frayed mountain bridge support, but AMyriad drops onto the decking and crawls to the far anchor.

Gulliver and Marcos leave the Mountains before the danger arrives, reaching The Tundra.
Across the border in The Tundra, Skizzo offers Marcos a safer path.

Tobi crosses the boundary into The Tundra and releases a heavy frozen awning above Joshi; the collapse kills him.

Tucked inside a ranger shelter, Ary discovers emergency blanket.

Hiro drops a heavy walkway brace onto Fauna below the swamp platform, striking her head and killing her.

Hiro stays still long enough to identify water bubbling beneath the reeds, then continues carefully.

The ground beside the sunshade holds something left behind. Ary picks up hand axe beside an abandoned sunshade.

Beside an empty cable reel in The Swamp, Tobi strikes Luvy in the head with the spiked mace while Luvy tries to move the obstacle; the fatal spiked mace injury ends the struggle there.
A half-buried case interrupts the smooth dune surface. Ary uncovers water flask inside a half-buried supply case.
Small branches shift above the trail. Marcos tests the footing on a slope covered in loose leaves, then chooses a firm place to rest.

Skizzo, Deaclaw and Adur check the way through the gravel strip beside a dry channel before committing to the crossing into The Swamp.

Frost clings to the trail markers. Deaclaw studies a fork beside a bent orange trail pole and marks a rough route map on the ground.

Ary, Marcos and Skizzo take the warning seriously and cross into The Mountains.
Fauna offers to steady spiked mace while Kowalik crosses a low rail in The Mountains, then keeps the weapon. From the far side, Kowalik has no doubt who stole it.

Following a dry leaf-filled gully, Shadz, Chaos, Suggs and Luvy avoid the main approach and cross into The Swamp.

Emma, Marcos and Chaos leave the Tundra before the danger arrives, reaching The Center Podium.
Shield's hand axe catches beneath a sorting tray during a struggle in The Center Podium; Flurris lifts the tray edge and claims the weapon while Shield retreats without being struck.
A low loading ramp in The Desert gives Tobi a sudden change of level when Ary swings the hand axe toward Tobi; the hand axe misses as Tobi drops behind its solid side.
At a turning inspection rail in The Center Podium, Hiro thrusts the spear toward Adur, but Adur ducks inside the bend and gets away without being struck by the spear.
The fern conceals a patch of ground beside the path. Joshi leaves picked berries beneath a fern to travel with less weight.
The soles have started to peel at the edges. Shield tears the soles off the squeaky boots, ruining the pair.
Joshi studies a fork beside a broken trail cairn and marks a rough route map on the ground.

Two approaches meet beneath a timing gantry in The Center Podium, bringing Kowalik face to face with Flurris. Kowalik drags a loose support cable across the crossing, tripping Flurris into a fatal fall from the gantry steps.
Light enters through missing sections of the roof. Gulliver and Suggs shift fallen shelving across a service corridor to make enough room to pass.

Tobi comes along the low approach to an inspection pit in The Center Podium as Deaclaw crosses its cover. Tobi tips a loose cover panel; Deaclaw falls onto the concrete below and dies from the impact.
Between two access gates in The Desert, Tobi catches the spiked mace across a fixed bar and levers it out of Akesel's grip; Akesel escapes through the other gate without injury.
The route markers stand above shallow drifts. Adur gathers loose material while Siegfried and Luvy put together a low windbreak built from packed snow. All three rest behind it.
With trouble announced, Shadz, Tobi and Kowalik head into The Swamp together.

The loop catches his ankle. Shield falls against a sharp rock, cutting the thigh, then tears the loose anchor free and escapes. The thigh is bleeding, but Shield survives.
Snow covers most of the emergency box. Chaos digs emergency blanket out of a snow-covered emergency box.

A reflective route plate in The Center Podium shows Siegfried which way Shadz is turning; Siegfried strikes Shadz in the neck with the machete, and Shadz dies beside the plate from the machete injury.
Gulliver releases an arrow toward Chaos through a mesh-screen opening in The Center Podium; Chaos pulls the screen across in time and escapes the bow and arrows attack untouched.

At a narrow service stair in The Center Podium, Rick prises the hunting knife from Deaclaw's hand against the rail, then drives the seized hunting knife into Deaclaw's chest; the injury kills him on the landing and leaves Rick armed with it.
Wind moves through gaps in the walls. Deaclaw, Ary, and Solus agree to use a chalk arrow on a concrete pillar as a meeting marker if they get separated.

Suggs follows a scuff toward a dead end in The Swamp. Chaos, still bleeding from the earlier shoulder wound, has doubled back behind a broad post and waits there rather than attempting another sprint.

At a narrow service stair in The Center Podium, Jokin prises the spear from Adur's hand against the rail, then turns the seized spear and thrusts its point into Adur's chest; the injury kills him on the landing and leaves Jokin armed with it.
Deaclaw destroys the Crooked Compass. For once, the next route will be chosen without an argument from the needle.
Hiro insists on keeping watch while AMyriad rests in The Center Podium, declaring that nobody else here deserves that kind of trust.
Joshi stays still long enough to identify frozen grass rustling beneath the snow, then continues carefully.
The problem with the Whispering Tin comes in a breakable form. Shadz destroys Whispering Tin. The accusations stop with a final metallic sigh.
Marcos, Chaos, Suggs and Hiro check the way through a packed track beside a frozen ditch before committing to the crossing into The Mountains.
There is little common ground beyond wanting the meeting to end. Deaclaw trades sealed rations to Emma for an agreement to leave this meeting peacefully.
A low loading ramp in The Mountains leaves Emma exposed when Akesel thrusts the spear into Emma's side; Emma drops behind the ramp's solid side, surviving with blood soaking the clothing at the side.
Emma waits beside a counterweight housing in The Center Podium while Marcos closes in from its far side. A kick frees the broken catch, and the falling weight crushes Marcos to death.
Between two offset gates in The Center Podium, Tobi swings the spiked mace toward Gulliver along the open lane; Gulliver turns through the second gate instead and evades the spiked mace unhurt.
Adur detonates an arena charge beside a barrier in The Center Podium, safely behind a concrete wall. A second wall shields Fauna, who retreats without injury.
Hiro waits beside a counterweight housing in The Center Podium while Adur closes in from its far side. A kick frees the broken catch, and the falling weight crushes Adur to death.
From a shallow pool, Siegfried recovers Crooked Compass.
Something left on the rock shelf catches attention. Ary retrieves an abandoned Crooked Compass from a rock ledge.
In The Center Podium, Marcos slides an empty basket toward Kowalik as a distraction, then seizes machete. Kowalik looks up quickly enough to identify the thief.

The trail passes beneath a suspended length of timber. Akesel uses a rope to rig a falling log above a supply trail in The Forest, then waits for Ary to pass beneath it. Ary hears the support creak and dives clear before the log hits the trail. The rope falls slack; Ary escapes unharmed.
The ground offers an alternative owner for the Whispering Tin. Marcos abandons Whispering Tin, tired of its running commentary.
Adur fires the crossbow toward Ary across a sorting stand in The Desert, but Ary drops beneath its tray before the crossbow can connect and escapes on the far side.

Shield gives two flashes with his signal mirror after spotting movement behind Jokin on a supply trail in The Center Podium. Jokin sees the signal and hides before the distant hunter reaches the path.

The delivery has left food to keep out of passing hands. Siegfried checks the sealed rations collected from the Center Podium delivery, then chooses a sleeping spot away from the supply lanes in The Center Podium. The food stays tucked close while Siegfried watches for anyone following the delivery route.

There is little spare warmth between the walls. Rick finds Suggs shivering beneath a supply shelter in The Tundra. They share his emergency blanket, sitting back to back so each can watch an approach until dawn.

Ary cuts Skizzo across the shoulder with the machete as Skizzo edges past a reflective route plate in The Center Podium; the reflection reveals the next approach, letting Skizzo reach the plate's broad support alive but bleeding from the shoulder.
Emma tests the footing on a snowdrift hiding uneven ground, then chooses a firm place to rest.
The canopy breaks the wind into small gusts. Jokin and AMyriad shift fallen branches across a deer trail to make enough room to pass.
Joshi waits beside a counterweight housing in The Center Podium while Skizzo closes in from its far side. A kick frees the broken catch, and the falling weight crushes Skizzo to death.

Shelter solves only half the problem of sleeping safely. Shadz repays the earlier shelter favor by taking the exposed end of a trail hollow in The Mountains. Rick rests behind the bank while Shadz watches both approaches, waking him only when it is safe to exchange places.

At a turning inspection rail in The Forest, Rick twists the crossbow out of Akesel's trapped grip and turns the seized crossbow toward Akesel and fires a bolt into his chest; the fatal attack leaves Rick holding the victim's crossbow.

A bank in The Center Podium offers a place to treat Deaclaw's earlier bleeding thigh wound. Adur and Joshi help Deaclaw reach it, then work together to wrap the injury with torn cloth. Once the bleeding has stopped, they remain beside Deaclaw for a rest.
Adur guides Ary's bow and arrows into the bend of an inspection rail in The Center Podium, twists it free of the trapped grip, and steps back with it while Ary retreats uninjured.
Akesel notices a taut cord beneath the leaves in The Swamp. Following it to a weighted snare, Akesel marks the danger with a branch and takes a wide detour.

Adur cuts Chaos across the thigh with the machete as Chaos edges past a reflective route plate in The Center Podium; the reflection reveals the next approach, letting Chaos reach the plate's broad support alive but bleeding from the thigh.
Skizzo catches a foot on a trail barrier in The Desert and falls against its jagged panel. The shoulder is cut and bleeding, but Skizzo gets back up alive.

Gulliver and Siegfried approach opposite sides of a loading rail in The Center Podium. When Siegfried climbs over, Gulliver shoves an empty trolley into the legs; the fall onto an exposed mounting bolt kills him.
Guest 26, Guest 38, Guest 40 and Guest 41 squeeze past a chain of firm reed hummocks and reach The Center Podium.
The station walls still divide the old routes. Joshi watches the approaches to a quiet corner behind the supply hall while Luvy rests. Then they exchange places.
The empty halls carry small sounds a long way. AMyriad offers Emma a steady hand at a gap in the broken station steps. Once across, Emma helps him follow.

At a narrow service stair in The Tundra, Suggs cuts Marcos across the shoulder with the hand axe from the upper landing; Marcos ducks beneath the stair frame and survives the encounter without stopping the bleeding at the shoulder.

Adur fires a crossbow bolt into Suggs's side as Suggs edges past a reflective route plate in The Center Podium; the reflection reveals the next approach, letting Suggs reach the plate's broad support alive but bleeding from the side.
Hiro packs up in the Tundra and escapes the weather by moving into The Center Podium.

Two approaches meet beneath a timing gantry in The Center Podium, bringing Akesel face to face with Shield. Akesel drags a loose support cable across the crossing, tripping Shield into a fatal fall from the gantry steps.

At a maintenance platform in The Center Podium, Adur reaches for Shadz across a damaged handrail. Shadz twists the rail out of its socket and drives the broken end into Adur's chest, inflicting a fatal wound.
After checking a patch of loose gravel below the ridge for a stable patch, Solus settles down for a short rest.

At a service shutter in The Center Podium, Flurris hears Fauna coming through the opposite passage. Flurris pulls the damaged release as Fauna passes underneath, dropping the shutter onto her and causing fatal crushing injuries.

Small ledges break the line of the mountainside. Emma and Solus shift loose stones across a mountain path to make enough room to pass.
